_about: The Table: Philadelphia, the bagman, the men above you.

scenes.title: Philadelphia asks about {capo.first}
scenes.text: The man from Philadelphia takes his coffee black at the Doo Wop diner and does not take off his coat. "Your {capo.first}. He's been calling people in South Philly. Our people. Asking how things are done." He lets it sit. "We wondered if you knew."

choices.label: "I sent him."
choices.hint: A lie to cover your man. Philadelphia checks.
choices.result: The man from Philadelphia nodded and paid for the coffee. {capo.first} owes you more than he knows.
choices.failText: He knew you were lying before you finished. Philadelphia will remember you lie to them.

choices.label: "He's ambitious. Maybe Philadelphia could use a man like that."
choices.hint: Give him up, and be rid of him.

memory.text: the boss offered him up to Philadelphia

scenes.title: A seat at the Table, for a price
scenes.text: The Table is hearing {rboss.call}'s complaint about the piers next month. A councilman's cousin says three of the five chairs could be persuaded, for the right consideration. Favors, mostly. Some cash.

opinion.why: Bought the Table out from under me

choices.label: Let the Table judge it fairly
choices.hint: There is a first time for everything.
